Name: Zabad, Son of Shimeath
Summary: Zabad, son of Shimeath an Ammonitess, was one of the servants who conspired against Joash for the blood of the sons of Jehoiada and slew him on his bed.
KeyStory: Zabad the son of Shimeath and Jehozabad the son of Shimrith conspired against Joash and slew him on his bed.
RelatedPeople: Joash, King of Judah; Shimeath, the Ammonitess
LifeLesson: Bloodshed repaid with bloodshed is the wages of a forgotten kindness.
